description: This file defines an interface for a factory that creates clients for Hono's Device Registration API. It includes static methods for creating instances of the factory with different parameters and a method to obtain a registration client for a specific tenant.

classes.name: RegistrationClientFactory
classes.description: An interface for a factory that creates registration clients for Hono's Device Registration API, supporting connection lifecycle management.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a RegistrationClientFactory instance for an existing connection, optionally with a cache provider.

methods.name: getOrCreateRegistrationClient
methods.description: Returns a Future that will succeed with a RegistrationClient for the specified tenant, or fail if unable to create the client.
